kind: ABI 6 guarded image write in the real game

mod.note: patches one verified byte at RVA 0x36f640, reads it back, restores it in the same call

observed_events.message: info: patch visible through a second read
info: original bytes confirmed after restore

meaning: A mod changed a byte of the mapped hyperdemon.exe through the host API, observed the change through a second read (so the write reached the image), then restored it and re-verified the fingerprint hash. Page protection was lifted by the proxy with VirtualProtect around the copy.
safety: Writes require build_matches (8/8 anchors here), are limited to 32 patches / 4096 bytes, are journaled, and are restored on rollback, on image_restore() and at shutdown.
content_policy: Only RVAs, counts and hashes are recorded; no game bytes are logged or committed.
